name: Domain Parking & Flipping

yield.notes: Parking income is minimal ($0.01-$0.10/visit). Real money in flipping (buy low, sell higher).

flags: Renewal fees drain capital on unsold domains
Cybersquatting laws limit certain types of speculation

prerequisites: Sedo or Afternic account for marketplace listings
startup_checklist: Research domain market using Namebio.com for historical sales data
Focus on .com extensions with clear commercial intent
Register 5-10 domains at $10-15 each in underserved niches
List on Sedo, Afternic, and Dan.com with competitive pricing
Set up basic parking page with contact form for inbound inquiries
failure_modes: Annual renewal fees (10-15/yr per domain) exceed parking income
kill_criteria: No offers received after 2 years on good domains
Total renewal costs exceed projected sale prices
sources_note: Sales data from Namebio domain sale records.
